structured.answer: I'd take the second one, because it tells me in plain Hebrew what's inside each fund, like the 125 biggest companies in Tel Aviv. But these are all share funds from a company I don't know, and nothing on the page tells me if they're as safe as my deposit.

stuck.why: Opens with funds, not savings; I almost left
Only 'ת"א-125', 'S&P 500' and 'MSCI AC World'; I take מדד to mean the price index, so it told me nothing
Three-line sentence 'שאינן במדד ת"א-35'; I lost it in the middle

stuck.where: Fee column, three lines per fund
stuck.why: Didn't know whether the fee is 0.35% or all three together

used: Screen 2's 'המדד ומה יש בו' column with the Hebrew descriptions
The 'קבוע' fee figure (0.35% stayed with me)
The sentence under the title about fees from each fund's report
skimmed: The tag labels under the names (צובר, מחזיקה את המניות, עסקת החלף, חשיפה לדולר, מס גם על שינויי המטבע)
skipped: The '<' arrows next to the index names
unsure_meaning: המדד (I read it as the price index)
not_found: Any word about how safe these are or whether they can lose money
Any comparison with a deposit or ריבית
One clear total fee per fund
Who the company is (it isn't a bank I know)

findings.what: Screen 1 shows only index names like ת"א-125 and English letters, with no explanation of what's inside
Three fee percentages per fund with no total; unclear which one I actually pay
Dark background with pale grey headings and grey text is hard to read even enlarged
findings.where: Column headings and the sentence under the title

findings.what: Unexplained jargon tags under every fund name
findings.where: Tags such as צובר, עסקת החלף, חשיפה לדולר, נאמן

findings.what: English letters in names (S&P, MSCI AC World, 4A/4D) make it feel like it's not for me
Page opens with 'קרנות סל', nothing about safety or savings
Long description lines break into three lines and I lose them
Teal-on-black links and numbers are hard on the eyes
findings.where: Index names and 'בדף הקרן במאיה' links
